'''Sharian Stranan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian shock trooper|shock trooper]] and a member of the [[Ash'ad]]. She participated in the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]] against [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|Mandalore the Avenger's faction]] and was killed in the fighting.<ref name="Ruhnuk" />
